note: v487: Follow-up pass on the new section switches. Settings → Notifications now hides when nothing left can send you one, and its reminder-time setting hides when you're not using recurring items. The Mileage tab no longer offers "Rebuild" (which rewrites mileage on every invoice) when Invoices is switched off. A couple of background lookups that ran on every screen — the bank list and the live tax estimate — now stop entirely for sections you turned off, so the app does less work and uses less data. Plus clearer wording in Settings → Sections about what switching a section off actually does.
